_comment: CANONICAL SITE NAVIGATION - single source of truth.
Edit this file, then run:  python tools/build-nav.py --wave N --apply
Two modes, chosen per wave:
standalone - pages with NO menu get a self-contained footer nav + mobile
dock between <!-- BLI-NAV:START --> / <!-- BLI-NAV:END -->.
families   - pages that already have one of the site's menu containers
(#mobileDockPanel, #menu-drawer, #navigation-menu,
#mobile-menu, #menuPanel) get the link list inside each
container re-rendered in canonical order. The wrapper and
its classes are left alone; only the items change.
The link list mirrors the homepage drawer (#menu-drawer in index.html).
index.html itself is NOT generated - it is the reference. If you change the
homepage drawer, change this file to match in the same commit.
Spanish twin auto-center/pay-dmv-fine/es/ renders Spanish labels via 'lang' + 'labels_es'.
espanol/index.html has English labels and is an ordinary families page.
_link_fields: icon   = Font Awesome class used by the drawer, dock and navigation-menu
tw     = Tailwind colour family for the #menu-drawer icon tile (bg-{tw}-50 / text-{tw}-500)
tw_a   = optional extra classes on the drawer <a> (homepage gives Espanol an emerald hover)
_towns: Areas We Serve dropdown on the old #main-header pages (wave 3). Local cluster first, then the two Charlotte-area pages.

_comment: Wave 1 (shipped ffb91ad) - public, indexable content pages that had NO
site menu at all. Excluded on purpose: bryson-layne/, mail-gateway/*,
shared/outreach-link-kit.html, social-media/reports/*, and
home-insurance/rates/methodology/ - all noindex or internal-only.
Wave 2 - every page that already carries a site menu container.
The page list is discovered automatically (any page under the repo
with one of the family container ids, minus 'exclude' and blog/blogs/).
Pass --pages to restrict.
Wave 3 - the old #main-header pages that still have a desktop link row
(<nav class="hidden md:flex">) and a Tailwind #mobile-menu. Both get
canonical content; the page's own Call / Quote buttons are kept verbatim.
Desktop: Home, Services (dropdown), Areas We Serve (dropdown, all 8 towns),
Resources, Blog, More (dropdown: Videos, Community, Espanol), Contact.
Wave 4 - blog posts under blog/blogs/ that carry the site's dock menu
(#mobileDockPanel). Discovered automatically. The v4 editorial posts
have no dock and a breadcrumb design by intent; they are untouched.
Wave 2b - bespoke one-off pages with a custom header but no site menu
and no mobile dock. Same treatment as wave 1.
Wave 6 (2026-09-17) added the four 2025-07 posts: their 7-link header bar stays, the standalone block supplies the canonical menu.
Wave 7 - every blog post with no site menu at all (v4 editorial posts and
the old minimal-nav posts). Footer nav ONLY - dock:false keeps the fixed
bottom bar off editorial articles. Discovered automatically; a post that
belongs to another wave is excluded; existing footer-only blocks are rechecked.

_labels_es: Labels used when a page is listed in 'lang' as es. Same hrefs, same order; Espanol stays Espanol (it is the Spanish hub link).
